ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is an equally spaced lattice of points, and the distances between horizontally and vertically adjacent points are both 1. Point A is located at a lattice point in the lower left, point B is located at the lattice point 3 squares to the right and 2 squares up from A, and point C is located at the lattice point 4 squares to the right and 3 squares up from A. Segments AB, AC, and BC form triangle ABC. Reasoning: Take A as the origin according to the problem statement, so A=(0,0). From the image, read B=(3,2), C=(4,3). The area of the triangle can be found using the determinant formula: area = 1/2 |x_B y_C - y_B x_C| = 1/2 |3·3 - 2·4| = 1/2 |9-8| = 1/2. Therefore the area of triangle ABC is 1/2.
